_why: What the built workbench is allowed to cost, in bytes, gzipped. `npm run check:weight` measures `dist/assets/**` plus `dist/index.html` after `npm run build` and fails when a metric is over its number or has nothing measured behind it. The budgets are hand-edited, deliberately: raise one with the reason in the commit, never by recording first. `fonts` counts the woff2 files as they are (woff2 is already compressed, and every unicode-range subset is emitted — a Latin learner fetches roughly 140 kB of the 302 kB). `largest_js_gzip` exists because the total can stay flat while one chunk doubles: the app is one 614 kB chunk today, which is the next thing worth splitting.
